tasks.task:
# Goal
Implement T4 of ticket #116 spec r6: byte-bound enforcement test, search guidance strings, and README compact-index contract.
Read `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket02-spec-r6.md` R4/R5, AC5/AC8/AC9, AD8/AD13 and T4 first.

# Files (exact write scope)
- internal/service/tools.go
- internal/service/tools_test.go
- internal/service/builtin_guidance_test.go
- README.md

# Required implementation
- internal/service/tools_test.go: add RED TestToolSurfaceSearchToolsByteBudget. Use measureResult on the full CallToolResult. Assert ≤2048 for exact-max unclipped AND clipped+degraded max-count responses with 64-char wire names. Variant split: maximum escape term uses fitting UNMARKED all-quote descriptions (18 quotes = 36 encoded bytes, D=36); over-budget all-quote input (24 quotes → 16 quotes + ellipsis = 35 encoded, D=32) verifies truncation/marker inside the envelope. Do not widen 2048/36/3/4.
- internal/service/tools.go: search guidance strings gain the compact-index sentence — hits carry tool_name, one-line bounded description, score; full schemas only via describe_tool; leave pinned-inventory sentence unchanged.
- internal/service/builtin_guidance_test.go: update expected guidance constants/strings to match.
- README.md Tool-surface section: rewrite the "Discovery responses are intentionally pruned" paragraph into the compact-index contract: hit fields, removals, match_count/truncated semantics, 3/4 effective caps over operator keys with existing configs valid, 36-encoded-byte budget with ellipsis and one-line normalization, ≤2048 serialized CallToolResult target, describe_tool as the only schema path. NO rollback-tolerance sentence and NO degenerate-config coherence statement.

# Prohibited
No instrumentation/metrics/events; no widening constants; no rollback or degenerate-config docs; no silent fixture narrowing; no unrelated files; no commits.

# Verify
Run `go test -count=1 ./internal/service ./internal/catalog ./internal/search ./cmd/mcp-bridge`, then `go test ./...` and `go build ./...`; report exact commands, exit codes, and any failure. If the AC5 byte test cannot pass within the §4 envelope, STOP and report BLOCKED (planner revision required), do not widen.
